items.quote: isn't buying in a wrong area. It's listening to people
items.statement: The biggest risk in Dubai real estate today isn't buying in a wrong area. It's listening to people whose job is to sell you one.

items.quote: involved in more than one billion deals
items.statement: I have spent eleven years in Dubai real estate, been involved in more than one billion deals.

items.quote: I am not an agent and I'm not trying to sell
items.statement: I am not an agent and I'm not trying to sell you any specific area, developer, or even a unit.

items.quote: not the one which gives you forty percent price growth in two years
items.statement: A property in a stable established area is usually not the one which gives you forty percent price growth in two years.

items.quote: unbiased advice away from the usual market pitch.
items.statement: I will give you unbiased advice away from the usual market pitch.

items.quote: the unit that gives you strong rental income is usually not the one which doubles in price.
items.statement: If you expect a steady rent cash flow, the unit that gives you strong rental income is usually not the one which doubles in price.

items.quote: the issue is buying an average unit in a place where average units are everywhere
items.statement: Investing in average units in high supply zones will lead to poor negotiating power with tenants.

overview: Transcript from a YouTube video discussing Dubai real estate market risks and investment strategies.
